MVHC operates twelve (12) locations within a four-county
region including Muskingum, Morgan, Guernsey, and Coshocton counties. MVHC serves over 73,000
patients annually, resulting in over 282,000 visits. MVHC offers services including primary care services,
women’s health, dental health, podiatry, behavioral health, and addiction services. Additionally, MVHC
operates two in-house pharmacies and one specialty pharmacy in Muskingum and Guernsey counties.  Our medical and pharmacy services are available to low-income patients on the sliding-fee scale, and we serve all patients regardless of their insurance.  In addition to providing free transportation to our patients, and offering Mobile Health services, we also provide free prescription deliver- impacting patients with transportation barriers to accessing healthcare.
